TI.P: appointing the Chairperson of the European Statistical Governance Advisory Board

PREAMBLE.PREAMBLE.INIT: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,

GR.VISA.VISA:
Having regard to Decision No 235/2008/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 11 March 2008 establishing the European Statistical Governance Advisory Board
OJ L 73, 15.3.2008, p. 17., and in particular Article 3 thereof,
Having regard to the opinion of the Commission,
Having regard to the approval of the European Parliament,

ARTICLE.ALINEA: Mr Johnny ÅKERHOLM is hereby appointed Chairperson of the European Statistical Governance Advisory Board for a period of three years.
This Decision shall take effect on the third day following its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.
